verdict.rationale: Render's own site says it serves static assets faster with caching on its global CDN, which matches the story's core directly. Community users praise Render's free static sites but do not mention the CDN or edge caching. missing for 10: in-depth docs on edge caching behavior (cache-control, invalidation/purge, PoP coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration of CDN performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: Serve static assets faster with caching powered by Render’s global CDN.
